g.text: vak — How It Works In Plain English
An intelligent AI agent platform built for humans who want real work done without giving up control, safety, or receipts.
Talk to your agent wherever you
work. It is never locked to one app:
AI tools. The same smart core
Is it a question, search, or edit?
Can only remove power, never add
If you ask a simple question,
Fast model for easy; deep for hard
vak doesn't just 'say' it is done.
It proves it with real evidence:
Codex-grade safety · pi-grade transparency · Claude Code extensibility · opencode simplicity.
vak solves the AI 'harness problem': an agent that actually acts in the real world while keeping your machine safe, your spend capped, and every action reconstructable.
